connectorUiConfig.title: SAP Litmos Org Activity Logs (via CCF) - Agency Academy
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Ingests SAP Litmos org activity logs into Microsoft Sentinel via the Codeless Connector Framework. To connect multiple SAP Litmos environments, deploy this connector once per source identifier.

sampleQueries.description: Show the latest SAP Litmos login events
sampleQueries.query:
SAPLitmosLogin_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: Show the latest SAP Litmos settings change events
sampleQueries.query:
SAPLitmosSettings_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: Show the latest SAP Litmos user profile change events
sampleQueries.query:
SAPLitmosUserProfile_CL
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

dataTypes.name: SAPLitmosSettings_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SAPLitmosSettings_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: SAPLitmosUserProfile_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SAPLitmosUserProfile_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions on the workspace are required.

customs.name: SAP Litmos API key
customs.description: A valid SAP Litmos API key with access to the org activity endpoints is required for each source.

instructionSteps.title: Connect SAP Litmos to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Enter your SAP Litmos API key.

parameters.content:
### Prerequisites
Retrieve your API key from the SAP Litmos Admin portal under **Account Settings > API**.

parameters.label: SAP Litmos API Key
parameters.placeholder: Enter your SAP Litmos API key
